summary: P95/P99 latency spikes and occasional request timeouts tied to continuous batching on dedicated capacity
description: Customer reports sudden increase in p95/p99 latency and intermittent request timeouts over the last 24 hours on their Dedicated pool. Issue appears correlated with continuous batching behavior—spikes align with batching window expansion. No config changes reported by customer. Affects both text-generation and chat endpoints.
impact: Customer observed 10-15% of requests hitting p99 > 2s (previously < 300ms p99) and intermittent 504 timeouts. Business impact: degraded user experience for production users; potential billing disputes if not resolved quickly.
steps_to_reproduce: Send steady stream of 1-2 token completions at ~150 rps to customer's dedicated endpoint
Observe tail latency over 30-60 minute window
Reproduce locally against a dedicated staging pool with similar traffic profile and model (redwood-instruct-13b)
observed_logs: 2026-02-28T14:12:03Z serving-runtime INFO batch_window expanded to 120ms (heuristic v1.24)
2026-02-28T14:12:03Z scheduler WARN high queue depth: 78 requests

investigation_notes: 14:20 SRE: Correlation found between batch_window heuristic change and onset of spikes — a runtime build rolled at 2026-02-27T23:50 referenced by deploy tag v2026-02-27-1 (possible change to continuous batching thresholds).
14:35 Eng: Reproduced p99 spike in a staging dedicated pool when batch_window expanded above 100ms and batch sizes exceeded 50 for short intervals.

14:50 Hypothesis: New batching heuristic increases window aggressively under certain queue patterns, causing large batches that exceed GPU scheduling sweet spot and trigger scheduling backpressure leading to timeouts.
15:10 Temporary mitigation: rolled runtime back to v2026-02-20 (batching heuristic v1.21) on one customer shard — observed immediate reduction in p99 and elimination of timeouts for that shard.
Action items: engage runtime team to patch heuristic, add circuit-breaker to cap batch_size, add telemetry for batch_window distribution per shard (ENG-2467).
